name: 林含怡
objective: This course focuses on thematic spoken interaction and aims to develop students’ ability to engage in meaningful, structured, and sustained communication in English. Emphasizing communication across both everyday and more formal contexts, students will learn to express ideas, respond to others, ask follow-up questions, extend discussions, and connect viewpoints around a topic or theme. Through pair interaction, small-group discussions, topic-based speaking tasks, and individual/group thematic speaking projects, students will develop greater confidence and fluency in participating in coherent and extended spoken exchanges in English. The course also serves as preparation for future coursework in professional English presentations and communication.
